# Hustl

> Hustl is a self-hosted invoicing and finance app for freelancers, solo self-employed people, musicians, artists and other independent creatives. It runs on your own server, with no cloud account and no telemetry in the app.

## E-invoicing facts (Germany, as of November 2026)

- Since 1 January 2025, domestic B2B businesses in Germany must be able to receive e-invoices.
- From 1 January 2027, businesses with a prior-year turnover above €800,000 must issue e-invoices.
- From 1 January 2028, all businesses must issue e-invoices, except small businesses under § 19 UStG.
- Small businesses under § 19 UStG must receive and archive e-invoices, but are exempt from issuing them.
- An e-invoice is a structured, machine-readable dataset according to EN 16931. A plain PDF is not an e-invoice.
- XRechnung is pure XML. ZUGFeRD/Factur-X is a hybrid PDF/A-3 file with embedded XML.
- E-invoices must be archived electronically (generally 8 years).
- Hustl creates ZUGFeRD/Factur-X invoices. XRechnung and receiving third-party e-invoices are not the core output.
- This is general information, not tax advice. Verify the current rules with a tax adviser.

## What it does

- Invoices, sequential numbering, PDF export and e-invoices according to EN 16931 (ZUGFeRD / Factur-X)
- Offers with versions, status and PDF
- Clients and projects with hours, fixed prices and open items
- Finance dashboard with income, expenses, fixed costs, forecast and monthly export
- Receipt PDFs, N26 statement import and payment matching
- Planner with dated tasks, recurring routines and free lists
- Light and dark themes that follow the system or stay fixed
- German/English UI, 12 currencies and a full archive

## Who it is for

Freelancers, solo self-employed people, musicians, artists and other independent creatives who want one calm place for projects, tasks, invoices and finances, no software subscription, and control over their data on their own server. Hustl is built for one person per instance: several passkeys, but no roles or approvals.

## Hosting

The recommended setup is a Debian/Ubuntu VPS with Docker and a domain. The installer sets up Docker, HTTPS in bundled mode, a daily database snapshot and autostart. Alternatives: an existing Linux server or NAS with Docker, a Raspberry Pi/home server, or a PaaS/Kubernetes environment with a persistent block volume and one replica. Shared hosting and serverless platforms without persistent storage are not suitable. The desktop app is a shell around a reachable server URL, not a standalone server.

## Requirements

- Linux host with Docker and persistent storage
- 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM minimum, 4 GB recommended
- 20 GB disk recommended
- Domain with an A record (AAAA for IPv6)
- About 15 to 30 minutes for the first build, plus DNS propagation

## Not included

SMTP email sending, GoCardless bank sync and Notion import are not part of the current release. The app is designed for one person per instance; multiple passkeys and devices are supported, but there are no roles or teams.
